title: 油价破百外资撤：印度指数走势艰难，专家仍让核心配印度，该信谁？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Indian investors have rarely had so many choices or so many reasons to hesitate.
segments.zh: 印度市场参与者很少面临如此多的选择，或如此多的犹豫理由。

segments.en: Oil of $100 a barrel is reviving inflation fears.
segments.zh: 每桶100美元的油价正重新引发通胀担忧。

segments.en: Foreign investors are selling Indian stocks. The rupees under pressure and benchmark indexes have struggled.
segments.zh: 外国市场参与者正在卖出印度权益资产。卢比承压，基准指数走势艰难。

segments.en: But experts still see opportunities beneath this office.
segments.zh: 但专家仍看到这些波动之下的机会。

segments.en: So where should you invest one crore rupees in India right now?
segments.zh: 那么现在在印度，你应该把一千万卢比配置到哪里？

segments.en: We asked four experts, years what they had to say.
segments.zh: 我们询问了四位专家，听听他们怎么说。

segments.en: They experts generally keep India at the core. They see opportunities in large and mid-cap companies with selective small-cap exposure,
segments.zh: 专家普遍以印度为核心。他们看好大盘和中盘公司，并选择性配置小盘股，

segments.en: especially across infrastructure, manufacturing, lending, data centers and renewable energy.
segments.zh: 尤其是在基础设施、制造业、贷款、数据中心和可再生能源领域。

segments.en: They also say diversification matters. Gold can protect against market shocks and rupee weakness while short-term debt, reads and infrastructure trust can provide income and stability.
segments.zh: 他们还表示分散配置很重要。黄金可以抵御市场冲击和卢比走弱，而短期债务、REITs和基础设施信托可以提供收益和稳定性。

segments.en: Experts also favor overseas exposure, including European stocks, global miners, semiconductors, batteries and different technology.
segments.zh: 专家还青睐海外敞口，包括欧洲权益资产、全球矿业、半导体、电池和不同科技领域。

segments.en: But some warn against chasing markets after they have already searched.
segments.zh: 但有人警告，市场已经上涨后不要追高。

segments.en: One expert suggests staggering investments over three to four months, rather than committing everything at once.
segments.zh: 一位专家建议在三到四个月内分批配置，而不是一次性全部投入。

segments.en: Several also say the final wish should reflect your goals, age and risk tolerance and recommend professional advice.
segments.zh: 几位专家还表示，最终意愿应反映你的目标、年龄和风险承受能力，并建议寻求专业意见。
